//: PRODUCTION CONFIG. Every REPLACE_WITH_* value below MUST be set before go-live. See backend/DEPLOYMENT.md. Prefer environment variables / IIS config / user-secrets for passwords rather than committing real secrets here (double-underscore syntax, e.g. ConnectionStrings__InnovationDb, Smtp__Password).
//ConnectionStrings: REQUIRED. Point at the production SQL Server (NOT localdb). Trusted_Connection uses the IIS app-pool Windows identity; switch to a SQL login (User Id=...;Password=...) if you don't use integrated security. Run EF migrations against this DB before first launch (see DEPLOYMENT.md).
//ActiveDirectory: REQUIRED. Used only in Production for LDAP identity resolution. ServiceAccount* should be a read-only domain account (or the app-pool identity's own domain user). Domain is the AD FQDN, e.g. corp.example.com.
//Smtp: REQUIRED. Production sends real email through this server. Leave Username/Password EMPTY to authenticate as the app-pool Windows identity against an internal relay; set them only if the relay needs an explicit login. RedirectAllToEmail must stay EMPTY for normal delivery.
//Storage: Absolute server paths (or UNC shares) for uploaded and generated files. The app-pool identity needs read/write. Defaults (if a section is omitted) are app-relative folders under the site — set absolute paths for production so files survive redeploys.
//EmailOutbox: Optional. Max delivery attempts before an outbox item is marked Failed.
